description: This file contains unit tests for an object pool implementation within the Orleans runtime streams. It tests object allocation, recycling, and resource management behaviors.

classes.name: ObjectPoolTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for verifying object pool behavior, including resource allocation, recycling, and concurrency handling.

methods.name: Alloc1Free1Test
methods.description: Tests that allocating and freeing a resource repeatedly results in a maximum of one resource allocated at a time.

methods.name: Alloc10Free1Test
methods.description: Tests that pre-allocating multiple resources and then freeing them tracks maximum allocation correctly.

methods.name: ReuseResourceTest
methods.description: Verifies that resources are reused properly within the object pool, and that allocation counts accumulate as expected.
